# Idle — Web Playables full brief

Idle is a parked research project for learning how idle mechanics, reusable HTML5 game infrastructure, and portable game distribution work in practice.

## Retained product

Idle Startup is publicly playable without an account. The player ships features, hires a team, raises rounds, accumulates offline progress, and resumes through versioned local saves.

## Reusable mechanism

The shared gamekit owns the simulation loop, saves, offline progress, pause behavior, platform adapters, and build boundaries. Game code is isolated from host-specific APIs so one mechanic can ship as a normal browser game and as a submission-ready YouTube Playable package.

## Current state and limits

The research goal produced one live game, a reusable kit, and YouTube-compatible packaging. The project is now parked. There is no promised next game, active paid product, account system, or public roadmap.
